assertions.subject: Infection due to human, dog, or cat bites
assertions.quote: Infection due to human, dog, or cat bites usually develops within 48 h.

assertions.subject: Rat bites
assertions.quote: Rat bites cause systemic symptoms such as fever, rash, and joint pain or true arthritis with regional adenopathy within about 2 to 10 days.

assertions.subject: Viral infectious arthritis
assertions.quote: Viral infectious arthritis is more likely to be polyarticular than bacterial arthritis.

assertions.subject: Borrelia burgdorferi arthritis
assertions.quote: Patients with B. burgdorferi arthritis may have other symptoms of Lyme disease ( or present only with acute monarthritis or oligoarthritis.

assertions.subject: Infectious arthritis
assertions.quote: Infectious arthritis is suspected in patients with acute monarticular arthritis and in patients with other combinations of symptoms characteristic of particular infectious arthritis syndromes

assertions.subject: Infectious arthritis
assertions.quote: Fluid from an acutely infected joint usually reveals a WBC count > 20,000/μL (often > 100,000/μL) consisting of > 95% PMNs.
